scope: Combine Claude commits through 49f3a18 with cinematic storybook library, title artwork and title-details composition.

artwork.origin: Generated with OpenAI image generation, using our earlier harbor.png as a reference. Coastal diorama with soft paper/clay texture, sailboat, lighthouse, saffron light and quiet teal space on the left.
artwork.purpose: Presentation illustration only; never a film frame or signed playback still.

individual_image_check.scope: Individual presentation image only, not screen transitions or native composition.

browser_preview.label: Browser layout approximations from actual React Native host trees, not Vega captures.
browser_preview.method: Actual rendered host nodes, actual text, actual flattened styles, approved original images and bundled Inter fonts. Host View uses flex-column, border-box and flexShrink=0; ScrollView uses its actual contentContainerStyle.
limitations: Browser flex and text layout approximate React Native Yoga/native text metrics.
Jest mocks do not provide native focus traversal, screen-reader behavior, scrolling-on-focus, rendering, media, persistence, or performance evidence.
Focus events and settings state are synthetic inputs listed in each tree file.
PNG screenshots are browser layout proofs, not Vega captures.

Axis-aligned native gradients use exported colors, locations and start/end points in an embedded SVG. Native interpolation and compositing can differ. Unsupported angle/diagonal gradients refuse rendering.
browser_preview.synthetic_inputs: Robin/Sam household, default viewing settings, real checkedShelf fixtures, simulated focus on Watch now, optional motion Off.
observations: All three library qualifiers are inside the bottom TV margin.
The full lighthouse and sailboat appear in the details panorama.
Watch now is visible on the first details view.
The story and practice-hold demo use distinct artwork.

validation.scope: Affected checks only, per the user request to avoid repeating the whole project review.
